pairs.target: yǔ zài tiānliàng qián tíng guò yízhèn , hòulái yòu qiāo shàng wūdǐng .
pairs.english: The rain paused for a while before dawn, then began tapping the roof again.
pairs.hanzi: 雨在天亮前停过一阵，后来又敲上屋顶。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xǐnglái , xiān mō chuángtóu de wàzi , zuì wàimiàn nàshuāng háishì gān de . tā chuān hǎo , tuī mén shí kànjiàn shí yán yǐjīng zhàn zài láng xià , shǒulǐ duān zhe zhōu , wàng zhe yǔ , yífù bùxiǎng ràng liǎngyàng dōngxī pèngdào yìqǐ de shénqíng .
pairs.english: Waking, Tavi felt the socks by his bed first; the outer pair was still dry. He dressed and opened the door to find Shiyan in the corridor, holding porridge and watching the rain as though determined the two should not meet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维醒来，先摸床头的袜子，最外面那双还是干的。他穿好，推门时看见石延已经站在廊下，手里端着粥，望着雨，一副不想让两样东西碰到一起的神情。

pairs.target: xiū péng nàbiān hái méiyǒu kāixiāng . ruì shīfu zài táixià chá yǔshuǐ wǎng nǎlǐ zǒu , jiào rén bǎ zuówǎn zhuāng hǎo de mùpán bān dào gāochù .
pairs.english: The depot had not opened its cases yet. Master Rui checked where rainwater drained beneath the platform and had yesterday’s completed tray carried higher.
pairs.hanzi: 修棚那边还没有开箱。芮师傅在台下查雨水往哪里走，叫人把昨晚装好的木盘搬到高处。

pairs.target: jīntiān yuánxiān yào jiāng xiǎo kuàng yùndào páng qú biān shìzhuāng , wàitou shíjiē shī dé fāliàng , tā xiān tíng le bānyùn , ràng liúshǒu de rén qù kàn shuǐwèi .
pairs.english: They had planned to trial-fit the small frames at the side channel today, but the stone steps shone wet. She stopped the carrying and sent the caretaker to check the water level.
pairs.hanzi: 今天原先要将小框运到旁渠边试装，外头石阶湿得发亮，她先停了搬运，让留守的人去看水位。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēn dào péng kǒu , kànjiàn zuótiān lùchū dàbàn de báishí zhī shèng yígè jiān .
pairs.english: Tavi followed to the shed entrance; the white rock mostly exposed yesterday showed only a tip now.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟到棚口，看见昨天露出大半的白石只剩一个尖。

pairs.target: ànbiān mùgān shàng qī de lǜ xiàn yě yǐjīng chén dào shuǐxià , shuǐmiàn dàilái jǐshù xì cǎo , zhuǎnguò hé wān jiù sànkāi .
pairs.english: The green line painted on the bank’s wooden pole was submerged underwater too. A few bundles of fine grass drifted past and scattered around the bend.
pairs.hanzi: 岸边木杆上漆的绿线也已经沉到水下，水面带来几束细草，转过河弯就散开。

pairs.target: yuè qín cóng xià tóu pǎoshànglái , xiédǐ quán shì ní . tā shuō shuǐ lái zǎo le , tōngzhī xiě de shì shǎngwǔ yǐhòu , shàngtóu gāi zhīdào kōngchuán hái méi nuó wán .
pairs.english: Yueqin ran up from below, her soles muddy. She said the water was early: the notice said after noon, and upstream should know the empty boats had not all been moved.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹从下头跑上来，鞋底全是泥。她说水来早了，通知写的是晌午以后，上头该知道空船还没挪完。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu wèn yǒuméiyǒu rén qù wèn . yuè qín shuō qù le yígè , huílái yǐqián , xiān bié bǎ mùliào wǎng xià sòng .
pairs.english: Master Rui asked whether anyone had gone to inquire. Yueqin said one person had; until they returned, do not send timber down.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅问有没有人去问。月芹说去了一个，回来以前，先别把木料往下送。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng shǒulǐ de xiǎo kuàng gē huí jiàshàng , hé shí yán yìqǐ bǎ tōngdào ràng chūlái . liǎnggè rén zhī bān yǐjīng fàngxíng de mùpán hé bùbāo , páng qú de jiù héng tiě yíjiàn yě méi dòng .
pairs.english: Tavi put the small frame back on the rack and cleared the passage with Shiyan. They moved only the released tray and cloth bundles, not touching a single old iron crosspiece at the side channel.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将手里的小框搁回架上，和石延一起把通道让出来。两个人只搬已经放行的木盘和布包，旁渠的旧横铁一件也没动。

pairs.target: yuè qín jiào rén cóng yuǎnchù shízhù qǔ shéng , shí yán qù ná , huílái shí dìgěi ànshàng yígè shúliàn de chuángōng , zìjǐ tuì dào tàjiǎoshí hòu .
pairs.english: Yueqin called for rope from a distant stone post. Shiyan fetched it, handed it to an experienced boatman on the bank, and stepped behind the footstone.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹叫人从远处石柱取绳，石延去拿，回来时递给岸上一个熟练的船工，自己退到踏脚石后。

pairs.target: yìtiáo kōngchuán de chuánwěi suízhe shuǐ bǎi , lǎnshéng bēngzhí , yòu sōngkāi .
pairs.english: An empty boat’s stern swung with the water, its mooring rope tightening then slackening.
pairs.hanzi: 一条空船的船尾随着水摆，缆绳绷直，又松开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn nà zhī shī liàng de tiěhuán , shǒuzhǐ běnnéng dì quán le yíxià , suíjí zhuājǐn zìjǐ bān de mùpán . tā bù guī tā , yě búshì pèiduì lǐ nà piàn xiǎo tiě .
pairs.english: Seeing the wet gleaming iron ring, Tavi’s fingers curled instinctively, then gripped his tray instead. It was not his to handle, nor the small iron sample in his pair.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见那只湿亮的铁环，手指本能地蜷了一下，随即抓紧自己搬的木盘。它不归他，也不是配对里那片小铁。

pairs.target: chuángōng huàn guò xìshéng de jiǎodù , lìng yígè rén jiāng cháng gāo dǐng zài shí yán , chuánwěi mànmàn zhuǎnguò qù .
pairs.english: The boatman changed the rope angle; another person braced a long pole against the stone edge, slowly turning the stern.
pairs.hanzi: 船工换过系绳的角度，另一个人将长篙顶在石沿，船尾慢慢转过去。

pairs.target: yuè qín zhàn zài shàngmiàn hǎn , bùxǔ bǎ rén jiá zài chuán hé àn zhōngjiān , shēngyīn chuānguò yǔ , shuí dōu tīng dé qīng .
pairs.english: Yueqin shouted from above not to trap anyone between boat and bank; her voice cut through the rain, clear to everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹站在上面喊，不许把人夹在船和岸中间，声音穿过雨，谁都听得清。

pairs.target: kōngchuán zhōngyú nuókāi , àn xià de jǐgè rén shànglái , kùjiǎo shī dào xīgài . yígè niánqīng chuángōng xiào zhe mà shuǐ bùkěn děng rén , yuè qín méi xiào , wèn tā gāngcái shǎoshōu de nà bàntiān gōngqián kěnbukěn yě děng .
pairs.english: The empty boat finally moved and the men below came up, trousers wet to their knees. A young boatman laughed and cursed the water for not waiting. Yueqin did not laugh; would the half-day wages he had lost wait too?
pairs.hanzi: 空船终于挪开，岸下的几个人上来，裤脚湿到膝盖。一个年轻船工笑着骂水不肯等人，月芹没笑，问他刚才少收的那半天工钱肯不肯也等。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn zhèlǐ , cái fāxiànzìjǐ gāngcái zhǐgù kàn chuán .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi realize he had been watching nothing but the boat.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见这里，才发现自己刚才只顾看船。

pairs.target: kuài dào wǔqián , qù wèn de rén dàihuí yìzhāng gài guò zhāng de duǎn tiáo .
pairs.english: Near noon, the messenger returned with a short stamped note.
pairs.hanzi: 快到午前，去问的人带回一张盖过章的短条。

pairs.target: shàng zhá tízǎo fàngshuǐ , shì běi qú jǐjiā gōngfáng gǎn jiāohuò , yòu féng shàngyóu yèyǔ , zhíshǒu de rén bùgǎn jiāng shuǐ quán yā zài hòutou .
pairs.english: The upper sluice had released early because North Canal workshops were rushing deliveries; with overnight rain upstream too, the keepers dared not hold all the water back.
pairs.hanzi: 上闸提早放水，是北渠几家工房赶交货，又逢上游夜雨，值守的人不敢将水全压在后头。

pairs.target: tōngzhī cóng shàng zhá fā xià , lùshang màn le yìchéng , shuǐ què méi gēnzhe màn .
pairs.english: The notice had left the upper sluice but lost time on the way; the water had not slowed with it.
pairs.hanzi: 通知从上闸发下，路上慢了一程，水却没跟着慢。

pairs.target: yuè qín ná zhe zhǐ zhàn le hěn jiǔ , wèn ruì shīfu , zhè tiáo néng bunéng jì zài jīntiān tínggōng de biǎo shàng . hòuzhě shuō néng , yòu wèn yào xiě shuí de míngzì . yuè qín bǎ méi zuò wán zhuānghuò de rén dōu jiào guòlái , yígègè shuō , bùkěn zhī xiě zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Yueqin stood holding it a long time, then asked Master Rui if it could go on today’s stoppage record. She said yes and asked whose names to enter. Yueqin called everyone whose loading was unfinished and named them one by one, refusing to list only herself.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹拿着纸站了很久，问芮师傅，这条能不能记在今天停工的表上。后者说能，又问要写谁的名字。月芹把没做完装货的人都叫过来，一个个说，不肯只写自己。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā yāzhù shī zhǐ . tā kànjiàn tā , hūrán wèn tóng jiē de rén shìbushì yě zǒng shuō shuǐlù piányi . tā méi gǎn tì suǒyǒurén dá , zhī shuō zìjǐ yǐqián kàn tú , yǐwéi yánhé zǒu zhí xiē .
pairs.english: Tavi held the wet paper for her. Seeing him, she suddenly asked whether Copperstep people always called water transport cheap too. He did not dare answer for everyone, only said maps had made him think a river route was straighter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她压住湿纸。她看见他，忽然问铜阶的人是不是也总说水路便宜。他没敢替所有人答，只说自己以前看图，以为沿河走直些。

pairs.target: " zhí shì zhí . " tā shuō , " shuǐ bù guǎiwān děng nǐ . "
pairs.english: “Straight enough,” she said. “The water will not turn aside to wait for you.”
pairs.hanzi: “直是直。”她说，“水不拐弯等你。”

pairs.target: fànhòu , jiù pénglǐ yǒurén jiào nài lěi , shēngyīn yíxià biàn le .
pairs.english: After lunch, someone in the old shed called Nerai, their voice suddenly changed.
pairs.hanzi: 饭后，旧棚里有人叫奈蕾，声音一下变了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài xīn tái biān , kànjiàn tā kuàibù chuānguò suìshí dài . ruì shīfu yě guòqù , zhī dào mùlán wài biàn tíngxià .
pairs.english: From beside the new platform, Tavi saw her hurry across the gravel strip. Master Rui went too, stopping outside the wooden barrier.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在新台边，看见她快步穿过碎石带。芮师傅也过去，只到木栏外便停下。

pairs.target: liúshǒu de rén zhǐzhe zuótiān xuán de tiě yàng , shuō méiyǒu huàn zǎi , kèxiàn què mànmàn nuó le . lìng yípiàn yuánlái bú dòng de , xiànzài yě bú zài jiù wèi .
pairs.english: The caretaker pointed to yesterday’s suspended iron samples: the loads had not changed, but the marks had slowly shifted. The other previously still sample was now off its old position too.
pairs.hanzi: 留守的人指着昨天悬的铁样，说没有换载，刻线却慢慢挪了。另一片原来不动的，现在也不在旧位。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén zhèngpèng zhe tāmen . nà liǎnggè xiǎo zhòngwù ānjìng dì chuí zhe , yǔ cóng yánkǒu luòxià , yìdī jiē yìdī , jìn dé ràng tǎ wéi xiǎng shēnshǒu qù mō yi mō .
pairs.english: Nobody was touching them. The two small weights hung quietly, rain falling drop after drop from the eaves, close enough to make Tavi want to reach out and feel them.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人正碰着它们。那两个小重物安静地垂着，雨从檐口落下，一滴接一滴，近得让塔维想伸手去摸一摸。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu huítóu kàn tā , zhī shuō bǎ xīn tái de xiāng gài kòu shàng , zànshí bùxǔ zài kāi zǎi .
pairs.english: Master Rui looked back at him and only told him to fasten the new platform’s case lids; no more loading for now.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅回头看他，只说把新台的箱盖扣上，暂时不许再开载。

pairs.target: tā zhào zuò , mù gài hélǒng , lǐmiàn nà fù shúxī de jiājù hūrán xiǎnde hěn yuǎn .
pairs.english: He obeyed. As the wooden lid shut, the familiar fixture inside suddenly seemed far away.
pairs.hanzi: 他照做，木盖合拢，里面那副熟悉的夹具忽然显得很远。

pairs.target: zuótiān de biǎo hái jiá zài wàitou , zhèngcháng de liǎngháng shù gāngānjìngjìng , jīntiān jiù pénglǐ fāshēng de shì , què yǐjīng bùnéng ná tāmen tì shuí zuò bǎozhèng .
pairs.english: Yesterday’s sheet was still clipped outside, its two normal rows clean and clear; but after today’s events in the old shed, they could no longer guarantee anything for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天的表还夹在外头，正常的两行数干干净净，今天旧棚里发生的事，却已经不能拿它们替谁作保证。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiào suǒyǒurén líkāi jiù lán biān , zìjǐ ràng liúshǒu de rén xiān tuì dào hòumiàn de shíjiē . tā méiyǒu shēnshǒu zhuā nà piàn tiě , xiān wèn zuìhòu yícì zhèngcháng dúshù shì shénme shíhòu , yòu wèn zǎoshàng shuí dòng guò zhá páng nàgēn lāgān .
pairs.english: Nerai sent everyone away from the old barrier and the caretaker back to the stone steps. Without grabbing the iron, she first asked when the last normal reading had been, then who had moved the lever beside the sluice that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾叫所有人离开旧栏边，自己让留守的人先退到后面的石阶。她没有伸手抓那片铁，先问最后一次正常读数是什么时候，又问早上谁动过闸旁那根拉杆。

pairs.target: yuè qín táiqǐ tóu , shuō fàngshuǐ qián tā kànjiàn guò zhíshǒu rén guòqù , dàn zìjǐ bù zhīdào lā de shì nǎ yìgēn .
pairs.english: Yueqin looked up and said she had seen the keeper go over before the release, but did not know which lever had been pulled.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹抬起头，说放水前她看见过值守人过去，但自己不知道拉的是哪一根。

pairs.target: hé shēng hái zài . tǎ wéi bào zhe kòuhǎo gài de xiāngzǐ , wǎng ruì shīfu zhǐ de gān dì zǒu . zhè yícì , tā méiyǒu huítóu qù cāi nà piàn tiě xiànzài jiūjìng yǒu duō ruǎn .
pairs.english: The river still sounded. Tavi carried the closed case toward the dry ground Master Rui indicated. This time he did not look back to guess exactly how soft that iron might now be.
pairs.hanzi: 河声还在。塔维抱着扣好盖的箱子，往芮师傅指的干地走。这一次，他没有回头去猜那片铁现在究竟有多软。
